alumia.texto: Your School achievements can appear on your Alumia profile: the card, the step, the workbooks you closed and how many lessons you did. You choose who sees them. It starts with nobody.
alumia.legenda: Who sees it on your profile

ajudas.militantes: Only people who are also in the School.
ajudas.seguidores: Only people you accepted as followers.
ajudas.todos: Anyone with an account who opens your profile.

alumia.desligado: Turned off: your achievements left your profile and what this device had declared was deleted from the server.
alumia.declaradas: Lessons and workbooks are declared by this device (the site does not check them); the profile shows how many lessons, never which ones. The card and the step are checked by the coordination.

consentimento.texto: Showing that you are an activist reveals a political opinion (Brazilian data protection law, LGPD, art. 5, II). You can turn it off whenever you want.
consentimento.detalhe: When you turn it off, everything leaves your profile at once and what this device declared is deleted from the server.
